_comment: Bootstrap seed for the roster allowlist — the only people who can sign in.
NOT the source of truth. Email and role are edited from /admin/members,
so this file will drift, and that is fine. The seed script inserts only
and never updates an existing manager_key, precisely so re-running it
cannot revert a change the commissioner made in the browser.
Run it with: npm run seed:members
Entries with a blank email are skipped — add those managers from
managerKey values are verified against edw.dim_manager on every run; the
script aborts if a name no longer matches, which is the tripwire for the
Python ETL renumbering a key underneath us.
